svg.title: Physical rotation and angular actuation
svg.desc: Orientation arcs, physical turns and actuator burns are different measurements. Values are available in dataset.json and the CSV downloads. Thin traces are actual paired-seed trials, not a median trajectory. Missing values are not drawn.
svg.text: Orientation arcs, physical turns and actuator burns are different measurements.
